name: finance-ai-monorepo
description: AI Expense Tracker with OCR, auto-categorization and budgeting

scripts.build: cd server && npm install --include=dev && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd server && npm install --include=dev && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.start: npm run build:client && NODE_ENV=production node server/server.js
